jmdict_e.attribution: JMdict Japanese-Multilingual Dictionary, Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG)
jmdict_e.modifications: Parsed the pinned JMdict XML snapshot; mapped ent_seq/k_ele/r_ele/sense structure into read-only SQLite schema v1; entity-expanded JMdict tag values are stored as their original tag codes; search columns normalized with oboe-search-normalizer/1 (NFKC + casefold + katakana to hiragana); priority markers folded into a derived common_rank. No upstream content was rewritten.

tomoshi.attribution: Tomoshi Dictionary Open Data by Y1Z; only zh_defs (zh-CN) rows plus table_licenses/meta metadata are consumed
tomoshi.modifications: Sense-aligned zh-CN glosses overlaid onto JMdict senses after per-sense fingerprint checks; misaligned rows quarantined to the QA report; zh_defs examples and all other Tomoshi tables are not imported; the zh-CN layer is machine-assisted and flagged is_machine_generated=1.
